_comentario: Datos de origen para tools/gen_palabras.py --libro firstwords («First Words», ver notes/06-first-words.md). Este fichero SÍ se edita a mano; content/firstwords/generated-*.tex NO. Trimestre 2 (invierno), días 66-130: dos palabras al día; llegan dos o tres letras para un sonido (sh, ch, th, ng, ai, ee, igh, oa, oo, ar, or, ur, ow, oi, ear, air, ure, er) y el resto de consonantes dobles (bb, dd, mm, nn, pp, rr, tt). Palabras de hasta cuatro sonidos, todavía sin dos consonantes seguidas.

actividad.prompt: In the living room, three Kings stand on a shelf. Every night they move a little closer, but nobody knows who moves them! Draw the three Kings.
Sam hanging up a big red sock for Father Christmas. He is sure that he is very good!
Lucía at the window, waiting for the Three Kings.

actividad.adivinanza: I am green, I live in a cage, and every time somebody comes in, I shout “Merry Christmas!” Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw a paper snowflake with six points, like Lucía's.
On Christmas Eve, Lucía's family has dinner at Grandma Rosa's flat. On the table, there are two red candles and a big fish. Draw it!
Everyone pulls a Christmas cracker: bang! Turn the zigzag into a cracker going BANG.
Mr Brown's Christmas pudding: dark brown, with a little green leaf on top.
everyone at Christmas lunch, in their paper crowns.
Draw the Christmas lunch next door: the tree, Pip's cage on the little table, and Toby under the table.
Happy New Year! In Spain, people eat twelve grapes when the clock goes “Dong!” at midnight. Draw Lucía's family with their bowls of grapes.
fireworks at midnight, and Toby hiding under the bed.
Lucía's New Year wish: a book in English that she can read on her own.

actividad.adivinanza: I go on your head when it is cold. Sam's one looks like a dinosaur, with green spikes on top. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw your New Year wish.
Dani writes a letter: “Dear Kings, I want a torch, so I can read in bed.” Draw his letter, with three crowns and a big star at the bottom.
The King cake is round like a ring, with a red cherry on top. Turn the circle into the King cake.
the little king that Amy finds inside the King cake.
sweets falling like rain at the parade, and Amy catching ten in her hat.
Draw the Three Kings' parade: the Kings on their camels, throwing sweets.
Snow! The school playground is all white. Draw a snowman as tall as a grown-up, with two black stones for eyes and a carrot nose.
the children throwing snowballs in the playground.
Lucía and Amy's chubby snowman, with Dad's old black hat and Mum's red scarf.

actividad.adivinanza: I am brown, I love the snow, and I try to catch the snowflakes with my mouth. When I come inside, I am white and wet! Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw a snowman in your garden. What does it wear?
Dani has got a cold, so he stays in bed with a hot water bottle and his toy dinosaur. Draw him in bed, with Toby on the rug.
Dani sips his medicine, a cure for his cold. It tastes of strawberries! Turn the oval into a strawberry.
Sam's card for Dani on the desk, and Dani's slippers under the chair.
Dani shouting the answer to Sam's riddle, and Sam clapping next door.
Draw something that makes you feel better when you are ill.
It is Peace Day at school. Marta's class paints a big white dove with its wings open and a green leaf in its beak. Draw it.
Lucía wants to play tag, but Amy wants to skip. Draw them both, a bit angry.
Lucía at dinner, feeling sad because she is angry with Amy.

actividad.adivinanza: When two friends are angry, one of them says this word, and then they give each other a hug. What is it?

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía and Amy, friends again, giving each other a big hug.
At the museum, there is a dinosaur that is longer than a bus! It has got a very long neck and a very long tail. Draw it.
A Tyrannosaurus rex has got big teeth and very short arms. Turn the zigzag into its big teeth!
the museum shop: Sam's cap with a dinosaur on it, and Dani's book about dinosaurs.
the dinosaur museum in the living room, with Toby guarding it.
Draw your favourite dinosaur. Is it big or small? Has it got long teeth?
It is Carnival! Lucía is a detective, with a long coat and a checked cap, and Amy is a green parrot. Draw their costumes.
the Carnival party in the playground: Dani is the head of a dragon, and Sam is its tail!
Pancake Day: a grown-up adds a little butter to a hot pan.

actividad.adivinanza: I am hot and round, and Mr Brown makes pancakes in me. When a pancake is golden, he turns it over! What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the costume that you would like to wear at Carnival.
It is very windy, so Dad takes the children to the hill. His big red and yellow kite flies higher than the trees! Draw it.
Amy and Sam's kite is shaped like a fish. Turn the triangle into a kite with a long tail.
Dad's hat flying away in the wind, and Toby running after it!
Lucía asleep, dreaming that she is flying like a kite over the city.
Draw a windy day. What flies away in the wind?
At the library, Lucía finds a book in English about a girl who lives on a boat. Draw the girl and her boat.
Lucía and Amy with their library books. They can keep them for two weeks!
Lucía reading on the sofa, and Amy lying on the rug. Hush!

actividad.adivinanza: I have got lots of pages, with pictures and stories inside me. Lucía reads one in English, about a girl who lives on a boat. What am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the cover of a book that you would like to read.
Marta's class is going to grow beans. Each child puts wet cotton wool and two beans in a cup. Draw Lucía's cup, with her name on it in red letters.
The roots go down, and the shoot goes up! Turn the wavy lines into a bean with its roots and its green shoot.
the beans on the window sill, in the sun.
a bean growing: the root going down, and the shoot going up.
Draw Lucía planting her bean in Dad's garden, with Toby digging next to her. She calls her plant Jack!
It is nearly spring! Under the chestnut tree, there are five yellow flowers, and a bee is looking for them. Draw Grandma's garden.
Jack, Lucía's bean plant, in the soil of Dad's garden. It has got four leaves now!
a red ladybird with seven black dots. Ladybirds bring good luck!

actividad.adivinanza: I am green, I live in a cage, and when I see a butterfly, I say all my words: “Hello! Toby! Biscuit!” Then I sing a long song. Who am I?

actividad.prompt: Draw the best thing about this winter.
